headline: AMSA Bans Bulker Over False Rest Hours
subheadline: Fatigue records are a PSC priority
insight: AMSA banned the bulk carrier Wooyang Venus from Australian ports for 90 days after finding falsified work and rest records, its third such detention.

sources.title: Australia Bans Bulk Carrier Over Repeated Falsification of Crew Rest Records
AMSA bans vessel over repeatedly falsifying seafarer hours of work and rest records
AMSA bans bulk carrier over repeated falsification of seafarer work and rest records

factCheck.notes: Facts cross-checked against at least two independent outlets or the primary statement; only verified facts used.

meta.description: The Australian Maritime Safety Authority banned the Marshall Islands-flagged bulk carrier Wooyang Venus from Australian ports for 90 days under section 246 of the Navigation Act 2012. A port State control inspection at Newcastle on 29 October, prompted by an MLC 2006 complaint, found work and rest records had been falsified and did not reflect hours actually worked. It was the ship's third detention involving falsified or incorrect hours records, after August 2026 and December 2023.
